newsitem.title: USA: Collaborative Clinical sees Q1 below expected.
newsitem.headline: Collaborative Clinical sees Q1 below expected.

text.p: Collaborative Clinical Research Inc said it expects first quarter results will be "significantly below" its original expectations.
The company earlier reported higher fourth quarter sales and net income.
"Although these results measured up close to our expectations, we are working diligently to strengthen our position as we enter the new year," said company president Jeffrey Green.

"We expect that the first quarter will be significantly below original expectations. We expect 1997 to be a challenging year, and Collaborative's financial performance will depend on our success in bringing new business on-line. Green said.
Green also said the company is bidding on a number of sponsor projects, and expects that success on a reasonable percentage of these prospects will bring it to a position that is more acceptable.
